darpan.datasource.DataSourceDefinition.description: The OMS order-items read as data (DAR-BE-176): orders with ship groups, items by order, product and facility names; one record per unit.
The OMS orders read as data (DAR-BE-176): sales orders by window or key, fields chosen by what the run keeps or filters on, exchange orders left out and listed beside the extract.
The OMS products read as data (DAR-BE-176): every product and NetSuite id swept whole, one record per sellable product keyed by its NetSuite id, plus a NetSuite id only a non-selling product holds.

The OMS returns read as data (DAR-BE-176): returns by entry-date window or id, the Shopify reference, items with order and product facts, an exchange's replacement order and the open return holding it.
